SELECT SEQTRADETRANSACTION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TRADETRANSACTION ( TRADEIDX, PRODUCTIDX, BUYERIDX, SELLERIDX, TRADEPRICE, SAFETYFEE, TOTALUSED_POINT, TRADESTATUS, RECIPIENTNAME, RECIPIENTPHONE, SHIPPINGADDRESS, TRADEDATE ) VALUES ( #{tradeIdx}, #{productIdx}, #{buyerIdx}, #{sellerIdx}, #{tradePrice}, #{safetyFee}, #{totalUsedPoint}, 'PAY_COMPLETED', #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingAddress}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TRADEIDX, PRODUCTIDX, BUYERIDX, SELLERIDX, TRADEPRICE, SAFETYFEE, TOTALUSED_POINT, TRADESTATUS FROM TRADETRANSACTION WHERE PRODUCTIDX = #{productIdx} ORDER BY TRADEIDX DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADETRANSACTION SET TRADESTATUS = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE PRODUCTIDX = #{productIdx} AND TRADESTATUS = 'SHIPPING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADETRANSACTION WHERE PRODUCTIDX = #{productIdx} AND TRADESTATUS != 'CANCELED'
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADETRANSACTION SET TRADESTATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE PRODUCTIDX = #{productIdx} AND TRADESTATUS = 'PAY_COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT FULLADDRESS FROM ( SELECT TRIM(r.SIDO || ' ' || NVL(r.SIGUNGU, '') || ' ' || r.DONG) AS FULLADDRESS FROM USERREGION ur JOIN REGION r ON ur.REGIONCODE = r.REGIONCODE WHERE ur.USERIDX = #{userIdx} ORDER BY ur.IS_ACTIVE DESC, ur.REGIONIDX ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT PRODUCTIDX, BUYERIDX FROM TRADETRANSACTION WHERE TRADESTATUS = 'SHIPPING' AND SHIPPINGDATE <= SYSDATE - 3

SELECT HISTORYIDX, PAYMENTIDX, TRADEIDX, AMOUNT, HISTORYTYPE, USERIDX, TOTALPOINT, TO_CHAR(CREATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM POINTHISTORY WHERE USERIDX = #{userIdx} ORDER BY HISTORYIDX DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PAYMENTIDX, IMPUID, MERCHANTUID, CHARGEAMOUNT, PAYMETHOD, PAYSTATUS, USERIDX FROM PAYMENT WHERE USERIDX = #{userIdx} AND PAYSTATUS = 'PAID' AND PAYDATE >= SYSDATE - 3 ORDER BY PAYMENTIDX DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
